request: Externally source 10 materially distinct, budget-conscious complete low-carbohydrate chicken dinners from verifiable public recipe pages. Focus this tranche on chicken breast or chicken thighs paired with substantial non-starchy vegetable accompaniments; exclude ground chicken, all seafood, standalone protein preparations, and any recipe already represented in the supplied catalog. Hard per-serving limits for the entire served meal: 500 to 650 calories inclusive and no more than 35 grams total carbohydrates. Accept only sources with a complete quantified ingredient list, usable published yield, and published per-serving calories and total carbohydrates; reject instead of estimating missing facts. The main and substantial accompaniment must both be included in the source serving and nutrition basis. Aromatics, garnish, sauce, broth, cooking fat, and seasoning do not count as an accompaniment. Require at least 70 grams of substantial accompaniment per serving after deterministic mapping. Preserve source quantities and yield, then support scaling to 14 servings. Favor ordinary affordable grocery ingredients and diverse cooking methods and cuisines. Verify each external URL and record its access timestamp. Do not pad the count with borderline, inaccessible, incomplete, or unverifiable recipes.
